Card Q&A.a: No, cards revealed from the top of your deck aren't considered to be “trashed from your deck,” so this card’s effect doesn’t activate.
Card Q&A.q: An effect that reads, “Reveal a card from your deck” reveals this card and trashes it. Does this card's “When this card is trashed from your deck” effect activate?

Effect: When this card is trashed from the deck, delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
[When Digivolving] Delete all of your opponent's highest level Digimon.
[Your Turn] For every 10 cards in your trash, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
